+
+## UBU-D0387: Mobile parity representation cases use frozen window starts and declared bounds
+
+**Status:** Accepted → DESIGN.md §16.10.6. Narrows `UBU-Q0160`'s harness evidence by materializing `UBU-D0370` beside `UBU-D0383`; API selection remains Open.
+
+Adopt `mobile-representation-pack/1` as the second synthetic fixture pack for the mobile parity harness. It replays `mobile-structural-pack/1`'s endpoint-equality and anchor/overlap cases with every absolute time translated to four frozen window starts: the structural pack's 2026 origin, 1970-01-02 as the origin-near control, and 2038-01-19T03:00:00Z and 2106-02-07T06:10:00Z, chosen so that the compared placements contain Unix seconds 2^31 and 2^32. Feasibility results and 60-second separations must be identical at every window start, and readback must match to the second. Slot and batch cases place the known valid and invalid candidates at the first and last Task slots and candidate positions under padding. Declared-bound cases build dependency chains whose final offsets lie one planning delta below, at and above each mapping's own declared range or arithmetic bound; the case above the bound must route to CPU stewardship with the unchanged request and seed.
+
+DESIGN.md §16.10.6 fixes the concrete values, expected structural results and freeze rules. Expected values are integers and contract timestamps independent of any encoder, checked against the untouched CPU reference before goldens are frozen; accelerator output is compared before CPU certification, and every offered case retains its actual accelerated or CPU disposition. The chosen magnitudes make common lossy lowerings observable without selecting a representation width: any mapping that preserves exact second-resolution semantics across its declared range passes, and a mapping that fails at its own declared boundary is withheld.
+
+This selects experiment inputs only. It establishes no fixture file, timing result, passing harness, numerical tolerance, representation width, compute API or schema change. The repair/branch-cache workload, named numerical checks, failure-ownership and sustained/concurrent requirements remain required; `UBU-Q0160` remains Open pending physically connected device measurements and operator review.
+
+---

 Freeze repetitions, order and cold/warm conditions under `UBU-D0364`, retaining every offered case and actual accelerated/CPU disposition. This initial pack supplies no timing result or complete qualification: all five repair triggers, branch-cache behavior, `UBU-D0370`'s representation/range cases, named numerical checks, failure ownership and the existing sustained/concurrent resource comparisons remain required. No fixture file, passing harness or API is established by this specification.
 
+**Representation-boundary fixture pack (`UBU-D0387`).** Use `mobile-representation-pack/1` to materialize the representation and range cases above. Reuse `mobile-structural-pack/1`'s conventions: contract UTC timestamps, `planning_delta_seconds = 60`, `rng_seed = 160`, atomic Tasks with fixed durations, pinned valid synthetic inputs for every other required field, and explicit candidate schedules fed through the existing hard-check/stage boundary. Offsets below are half-open second offsets from the named window start; one planning delta is the separation unit, and readback is compared at the contract's one-second timestamp resolution. Each row is an independent fixture family whose exact Task ids, topological order, masks, stage inputs and expected values are frozen before trials. Unix seconds are given only to make the chosen magnitudes checkable; fixtures carry contract timestamps.
+
+| Case | Concrete input | Required structural result |
+| --- | --- | --- |
+| P1: translated endpoint pairs | Replay M2's three B placements and M5's three anchor/overlap checks with every absolute time translated so that the [0,3600) window starts at W0 = 2026-10-16T09:00:00Z (Unix second 1792141200, the structural pack's T), W1 = 2038-01-19T03:00:00Z (2147482800), W2 = 2106-02-07T06:10:00Z (4294966200) and W3 = 1970-01-02T00:00:00Z (86400). Every B placement at W1 contains second 2147483648 and at W2 contains second 4294967296; every absolute second at W0 exceeds 2^30, where single-precision seconds are spaced 128 apart. | Results are identical at all four window starts: M2 gives dependency/hard-constraint feasibility false/false, true/true and true/true, and M5 gives true/false, true/false and true/true. Decoded/readback timestamps and durations equal the inputs to the second. A result that varies with the window start fails, whether by wrap, saturation or collapse of the 60-second separation; W3 distinguishes a magnitude-dependent failure from a wrong relative rule. |
+| P2: slot and batch boundaries | Place M2's equality candidate with A in Task slot 0 and B in slot 255 of a 256-slot mask, then exchange the slots; slots 1–254 are inactive under false masks and carry overlapping [0,3600) intervals. Separately place M6's valid and invalid candidates at the first and last positions of the frozen mapping's declared maximum candidate batch, padding the remaining positions the same way, then exchange them. | Masks, both feasibility fields, rejection classes and readback slot indices equal the unpadded `mobile-structural-pack/1` results. No padded slot or position contributes an interval, result or rejection, and the invalid candidate cannot abort or contaminate the valid one at either position. |
+| P3: declared bounds | For each frozen mapping's declared supported range or intermediate arithmetic bound on offsets, durations and their sums, in its declared unit, build a dependency chain of at most 256 atomic Tasks with fixed durations that are multiples of the planning delta, placed back to back from offset 0 in a window just long enough, so that the chain's final end offset is one planning delta below the bound, exactly at the bound and one planning delta above it. Translate each request to W3 as its control. Record a bound unreachable by any contract-valid request with that justification instead of a fixture. | The CPU reference reports the same feasible chain for all three requests and their controls. The candidate executes the first two with exact parity and routes the third to CPU stewardship with the unchanged request and seed under the existing budget and fallback rules, recorded as CPU fallback in `UBU-D0364`'s accounting rather than as a semantic rejection, silent overflow or truncation. A mapping that fails at its own declared boundary is withheld. |
+
+P1 exercises translation and magnitude, P2 indexing and P3 each mapping's own limits, so P3's concrete windows are frozen with the mapping under `UBU-D0364`'s manifest before acceptance runs. W0, W1 and W2 place the compared seconds beyond 2^30 and across 2^31 and 2^32, making common lossy lowerings observable without selecting a representation width: any mapping that preserves exact second-resolution interval semantics across its declared range passes. Expected values are integers and contract timestamps independent of any candidate's encoder or decoder; check them against the untouched CPU reference before freezing goldens and diagnose a discrepancy before acceptance. Compare accelerator output before CPU certification and retain every offered case with its actual accelerated or CPU disposition. This pack supplies no timing result, passing configuration, numerical tolerance or API; the repair/branch-cache workload, named numerical checks, failure ownership and the sustained/concurrent resource comparisons remain required.
+
